brief: Ukraine's vendor-side disclosure landscape splits cleanly into three tiers. First, domestic banking-software and processing vendors publish the richest indirect intelligence: CS Ltd (CBS B2, self-described #1 core banking system in Ukraine, naming OTP Bank, Bank Lviv and BISbank), UNITY-BARS (ABS BARS, COPR2/Corplight), UPC and UKRCARD on the processing side, and ProFIX on payments connectivity — their press centres and case-study pages are effectively the public register of which private bank runs what. Second, international vendors disclose Ukraine only sporadically but with high reliability when they do: Tietoevry's regulated releases document the UPC open-banking partnership and the earlier Card Suite cross-border acquiring launch, while no Ukrainian engagement could be found for the ATM OEMs, BPC/OpenWay/Temenos, or the card-personalisation majors — an unresolved gap rather than a confirmed absence. Third, because PrivatBank, Oschadbank and Ukrgasbank are state-owned, Prozorro carries genuine hardware procurement records (ATM and ATM-component lots, mobile POS/acquiring service contracts) that name suppliers and prices, giving a hard-evidence baseline against which private-bank capex can be inferred; local trade press (PaySpace Magazine, FinClub, AIN.UA) and the state company register via YouControl complete the actor map. Priority next steps are the Prozorro API by buyer EDRPOU and CPV code, and a Ukrainian-language glossary pass over the ATM, cards and cash-handling segments, which remain English-only and therefore under-covered.
